biotools.summary: Single-file offline HTML application for quality-control review, control charting and audit of real-time PCR (qPCR) runs. It reads IXO, EDS/EDT, RDML, ZPCR and PCRD instrument files directly in a browser with no installation, server or network connection, checks each run against a stored laboratory SOP profile, charts instrument and assay parameters across runs, and exports figures, tables and a signed report with identifiers optionally pseudonymised.
